messages:
linh-customer: Hey team — onboarding blocked for AcmeCorp. JS SDK v0.9.2 init returns 401 on the first inference call, then 429 after two retries. Request id: req_0a1b2c. We need this for tomorrow's demo, any quick ideas?

kate-cs: Thanks for flagging, @linh-customer. Can you paste the minimal repro curl or SDK snippet and the response body/headers? Also what API key scope was used?

linh-customer: Sure — here's the exact snippet they run (from their server):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-base', prompt: 'hello' });
```
Response (truncated):
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
Request-Id: req_0a1b2c

{ "error": { "type": "invalid_token", "message": "token not valid" } }

After we retried twice with the same key we hit 429: Too Many Requests. No X-Client-Telemetry header present.

devex-jordan: Hmm — two things to triage: (1) 401 suggests token invalid or wrong scope, (2) 429 after retries could be client-side retry flooding the hosted API defaults. Can you confirm whether the API key was generated by their admin (full inference scope) or created by an invite (limited scopes)?

linh-customer: They said ops created the key via the Console UI during onboarding, default settings. I asked for the console export and they pasted the key, but not the scope metadata. I can escalate for a screenshot.

samir-eng-runtime: Quick note from runtime: we recently tightened scope enforcement. A bug edge-case returns 401 for missing inference:create scope instead of 403 — that would look like "invalid_token" to the SDK. If the key is from a service account with only embeddings scope we would see this.

samir-eng-runtime: Also, our SDK v0.9.2 doesn't set the X-Client-Telemetry header in some serverless setups — our rate limiter relies on that header for client-id grouping. Missing it can cause retries to be counted per-request and trip 429s faster. We're working on a small patch.

kate-cs: So root causes could be (a) wrong scope key -> 401, and (b) missing telemetry header -> amplified 429 on retries. Customer is blocked for demo; what are next steps?

devex-jordan: Action items:
- @linh-customer: please confirm the key id (last 6 chars) and paste the exact Request-Id for one 401 and one 429 (you already gave req_0a1b2c for the 401).
- I'll push a hotfixed SDK (v0.9.3) build that ensures telemetry header and improves retry jitter.
- @samir-eng-runtime: can you create a short runtime patch to return 403 for scope-mismatch so it's clearer? Also can you add a temporary whitelist for this onboarding org to avoid hitting the quota while we fix client retries?

quota-bot: Quota request created: ticket CS-987 (AcmeCorp) — temporary throughput increase to 2x for 24h. Owner: kate-cs.

linh-customer: Req ids collected: 401 -> req_0a1b2c (attached logs), 429 -> req_0a1b2f. Key id ends with ...c9b2. They confirmed the key was created by a teammate who said "default access".

samir-eng-runtime: Thanks. I opened ENG-1124 for the error-code fix and ENG-1125 to add the org to the temporary quota whitelist. Targeting rollback-safe patch within 4 hours.

devex-jordan: Uploading a quick SDK build here: https://artifacts.redwood.dev/v0.9.3/hotfix. Instructions: replace package and restart the process. It will add header: X-Client-Telemetry: rw-js/0.9.3; also backs off with exponential jitter.

kate-cs: I'll schedule a 30-min enablement call with AcmeCorp at 15:00 PST and loop in @samir-eng-runtime and @devex-jordan. If we can't get them unblocked today, classify as high renewal risk and escalate to AM.

linh-customer: Installing v0.9.3 now and will test. Appreciate the quick turnaround — will update here in ~20m.

devex-jordan: If you still get 401 after the SDK patch, try a test with an admin key to confirm scope. If admin key works -> reissue proper scoped key and rotate.

kate-cs: Noted — capture this in the CS ticket (CS-987) with the replay steps and the enablement call invite so AM can follow up on renewal.

linh-customer: Update: v0.9.3 fixed the 429 (telemetry header present). Still seeing 401 with the same key. Admin test key worked. Looks like scope mismatch.

kate-cs: OK great progress — we'll coordinate key rotation with them during the call and make sure they have a valid key before the demo. Follow-up: capture feedback about SDK telemetry and the confusing 401 message in product docs.

samir-eng-runtime: I'll change the 401 -> 403 behavior in prod after validation and add a small note to the API errors doc. Leaving ENG-1124 and ENG-1125 linked to CS-987.

linh-customer: Call scheduled, customer happy with temporary quota and fix plan. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
